name: cloud_scheduler_job_failure_count
description: Counts Cloud Scheduler attempt-finished log entries at severity ERROR (job fired but the target did not succeed: NOT_FOUND, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, INTERNAL, UNAVAILABLE, UNKNOWN, ...). This is the ONLY signal that survives a target the worker never receives: a 404'd job produces no worker log, no Sentry event, and no dead-man tick, so every in-repo monitor is structurally blind to it. `generate-reports` 404'd hourly for ~4.5 months (~3,300 consecutive failures from 2026-03-16) without a single alert because nothing consumed this log stream.

labels.description: Cloud Scheduler job id (from the log entry's monitored resource).
Canonical failure status from the attempt, e.g. NOT_FOUND, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, INTERNAL, UNKNOWN.
